profile.summary: Canvasback Missions is a nonprofit based in Benicia, California. It brings specialty health care, health education and wellness programs, including diabetes intervention, to the people of Micronesia and the Pacific Islands. It also runs Rooted Future, a youth leadership and service program with clubs in Oakland high schools.
